objective: Discover, under an explicitly charged finite search, whether a source-decodable Megatron-Core/PyTorch-CUDA procedural Philox anchor explains enough final Qwen3 expert-weight energy to contribute to the 20-percent-below-Gaussian target.

claim_boundary.public_evidence: The pinned Megatron-Core source documents one expert RNG seed formula and current module shapes; no primary source documents that Qwen used Megatron-Core, this commit, these layouts, any searched seed, or this construction order.
claim_boundary.positive_result: auxiliary procedural survivor requiring a separately frozen gate-role experiment and full physical codec replay
claim_boundary.negative_result: rejects only this finite Tier-B procedural key family
claim_boundary.forbidden_claim: No candidate or winner may be described as Qwen's production initializer or training lineage. Tier-A artifacts and conclusions are independent and unchanged.

source_firewall.cohort: the same 32-file layer-15 auxiliary cohort used by completed Tier A
source_firewall.tier_b_payload_access_status_at_lock: no Tier-B candidate, coordinate plan, or null-domain value has been evaluated against a payload
source_firewall.validation_rule: all 33 domain winners are frozen and state-backed before validation payloads open

procedural_family.pipeline_parallel_seed_effect: megatron/training/initialize.py first adds 100*pipeline rank; PP also changes layer-15's local stage position and persistent expert-stream offset
procedural_family.stream_scope: one persistent expert RNG stream per EP/ETP rank from the start of its pipeline stage
procedural_family.construction_order: numeric local layer, numeric local expert, then locked projection packing
procedural_family.initializer_distribution: standard-normal shape only; affine fitting absorbs documented initializer scale
procedural_family.authoritative_runtime: PyTorch 2.8 CUDA normal_ / cuRAND Philox4x32-10 semantics on the bound RunPod
procedural_family.decoder_output: float32 standard-normal anchor; BF16 paths are parity checks, not additional searched keys

logical_key_space.tie_break: minimum metric, then smallest logical ordinal

equivalence_deduplication.proof_scope: under the end-to-end locked seed rule, PP1 and PP2 both place global layer 15 at rank 0/local layer 15; PP4 is rank 1/local layer 3 and PP8 is rank 2/local layer 3
equivalence_deduplication.representative_rule: smallest logical ordinal in each exact PP-equivalence class

coordinate_protocol.full_allocation: quotient-remainder over all 31 eligible matrices in frozen source order
coordinate_protocol.stage0_allocation: quotient-remainder over the 23 selection matrices in frozen source order
coordinate_protocol.algorithm: revision/tensor/split-domain-separated SHA256 rejection sampling; fit and score disjoint within each plan

null_domains.gaussian_rule: stateless SHA256 Box-Muller, independently domain-separated and matched to per-matrix fit-only source mean and centered RMS
null_domains.scramble_rule: independent SHA256 permutation and Rademacher sign of source deviations around the fit-only mean, separately within matrix and split

stage0.metric: two role-global fit-only affine regressions on 256 fit coordinates; pooled q on 256 score coordinates

stage1.metric: independent per-matrix float64 fit-only affine regression; pooled selection q on full score coordinates

validation.payload_open_rule: only after all 33 stage1 winners and their state hashes are frozen
validation.metric: per-matrix fit-only affine regression and score-only q/correlation
validation.folds: four whole experts and two roles

search_cascade.note: The total reflects exact PP-equivalence deduplication; all 37,748,736 logical ordinals remain charged and tie-resolved. Domain arithmetic reuses anchors and does not change generated-value count.

chance_search_control.validation_correction: C_star = source validation capture - max(0, all 32 matched null-winner validation captures)
chance_search_control.empirical_familywise_rule: source validation capture must exceed every null validation capture; minimum attainable randomization p is 1/33

promotion.composite_survivor: C_star - 3 SE >= composite requirement, source beats all 32 nulls, all four source whole-expert folds positive, both source role folds positive, and read amplification <2
promotion.standalone_survivor: same conditions with C_star - 3 SE >= standalone requirement
